text: As junior doctors continue their strike to protest working conditions, students are making plans to return.
As junior doctors continue to strike in protest of their working conditions, students are making plans to return.
To protest government proposals to raise medical school admissions, students and trainee doctors staged a walkout, claiming it would diminish the quality of their education.

During a rally in Seoul on March 3, 2024, a doctor displays a sign that says "Save Emergency Physician to Protect Emergency Patients" in opposition to the government's proposal to increase the yearly enrollment quotas at medical schools.
